sources.title: LibRaw 0.21.4 binary import reference and public C API configuration
sources.citation: LibRaw 0.21.4-Release for Linux x86-64, Debian binary packages libraw23t64 and libraw-dev 0.21.4-2+deb13u1; a first-party client compiled against the matching public C API declarations. Runtime package: https://deb.debian.org/debian/pool/main/libr/libraw/libraw23t64_0.21.4-2+deb13u1_amd64.deb . Development package: https://deb.debian.org/debian/pool/main/libr/libraw/libraw-dev_0.21.4-2+deb13u1_amd64.deb . Published binary-package checksums were checked through https://packages.debian.org/trixie/amd64/libraw23t64/download and https://packages.debian.org/de/trixie/amd64/libraw-dev/download . Official public API documentation used to configure calls, ownership and rendering options: https://www.libraw.org/docs/API-C.html , https://www.libraw.org/docs/API-datastruct.html , https://www.libraw.org/docs/API-CXX.html and https://www.libraw.org/docs/API-notes.html . Current website documentation was cross-checked against the installed 0.21.4 public declarations; it is not represented as a frozen 0.21.4 documentation snapshot. This binary profile is separate from SRC-009 (rawpy 0.27.0 / LibRaw 0.22.1).
sources.permittedUse: Execute the checked LibRaw binary as a black box to obtain full native sensor samples, metadata, observable errors/warnings and explicitly configured RGB8/RGB16 reference outputs; bind every observation to original-input and complete-output hashes. Use the official public C/C++ API documentation and matching installed public ABI declarations only to build and configure the first-party client, including raw-pitch access, consumer-owned materialization and context cleanup. Compare complete import latency and process memory only with declared input, CPU, startup/cache, output geometry, transfer/quality, ownership and serialization boundaries. No product runtime dependency or external implementation derivation is introduced by this reference use.
sources.prohibitedUse: Consulting, translating or incorporating third-party decoder implementation source, disassembly, decompiled code, internal algorithm snippets or constants of unverified origin; deriving CRX bitstream semantics from public API declarations or treating an external decoder rejection as a format specification. Do not conflate this 0.21.4 profile with SRC-009, treat differing developed RGB/crop policies as native-sensor failures, or present borrowed-output/CLI-serialization/startup measurements as equivalent complete owned API imports. Do not infer support or performance for unmeasured cameras, profiles, runtimes or inputs.
